svg.title: Toonverse wireframe 02: Profile
svg.text: Low-fidelity wireframe, not a final UI design · Toonverse Task 011 (0.11) · Desktop-first (Issue #17 D5)
Only name and bio can be edited here. Email, role
and premium status are read-only (data model).
Each form has its own loading, error and success
Loading: the button shows "Saving..." and is disabled.
P2 - lower priority, done if time allows
Only the user's own payments, newest first.
Password change returns 204: show a short success
message and clear both password fields.
Password must be at least 8 characters.
400 WRONG_PASSWORD: the current password does not
400 VALIDATION_ERROR: the new password breaks the rule.
Bio can be at most 300 characters.
Couldn't save your profile. Try again.
Profile form, password form and payment history
Payment history becomes a list of small cards
Q9). Fields from docs/api.md Part 3 Payment.
